title: "CS07 RAM Compatibility, Installation, and Verification"
description: "Research, install, and verify a teacher-approved memory upgrade."
pathway: "Main Quest"

**Pathway:** {{< meta pathway >}}\
**Prerequisites:** CS02, CS05, CS06\
**Previous:** [CS06 Linux Mint Xfce](cs06-linux-mint.qmd)\
**Next:** [CS08 Benchmark challenge](cs08-benchmark-challenge.qmd)

Record the baseline in BIOS/UEFI and Linux. Research DDR generation, DIMM/SODIMM form factor, capacity limits, supported speed, ECC requirement, voltage, and slot arrangement from the exact system documentation.

After teacher approval, shut down, unplug, apply ESD controls, align the notch, and seat the module without forcing it. Verify the new capacity in firmware and Linux, then repeat one baseline test.

If POST fails, remove power before checking seating and restore the documented baseline. Do not swap random parts.

Submit the compatibility table, before/after photographs, firmware and Linux verification, and revised asset record.
